fields.name: slot
fields.description: One of your open trade slots (see `get_trade_slots`): `"trade1"` to `"trade30"`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The item that you want to buy. Not `"placeholder"`.

fields.name: q
fields.description: The quantity, 1 to 9,999. For an upgrade or compound item, at most 99.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The gold for each unit, 1 to 99,999,999,999.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Upgrade or compound items only: the level, 0 to 12.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The slot gets the wishlist entry `{name, rid, price, b: true, q, level?}`. `rid` is 4 random characters. The entry replaces an older wishlist entry in the slot.

rows.when: `slot` is not one of `trade1` to `trade48`, `name` is not a key of `G.items`, or `name` is `"placeholder"`.
The slot holds a listing (an item without the flag `b`). The code has this spelling.

The slot is not open for you: with a stand, `trade1` to `trade16` (24 for a merchant at level 70 or with a `cstand`, 30 for a merchant at level 80); without a stand but with `p.trades`, `trade1` to `trade4`; else none.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true` and the wishlist entry in `slots`, with `price`, `rid` and `b`.
